caption_en:
3,000 years. Still standing. Why? 🥊

Round 1: Pharaoh's Egypt. Slavery, then the walk out (Book of Exodus, tradition).
Round 2: Babylon takes Jerusalem and destroys the First Temple, 586 BCE (2 Kings 25; Babylonian Chronicles).
Help from the corner: Cyrus of Persia takes Babylon in 539 BCE and lets the exiles go home (Ezra 1; the Cyrus Cylinder, British Museum).
Round 3: Haman's plot (Book of Esther, tradition).
Round 4: Rome destroys the Second Temple, 70 CE (Josephus, The Jewish War; Arch of Titus).
Round 5: Spain's crown expels its Jews, Alhambra Decree, 31 March 1492.
Round 6: the Holocaust. 6 million Jews murdered (US Holocaust Memorial Museum).
14 May 1948: Declaration of Independence.
1973: Yom Kippur War. The US airlift, Operation Nickel Grass, flew in 22,325 tons in 32 days (US Air Force).
Then the training: an army, startups, Iron Dome. In May 2021 it stopped about 90% of the rockets heading for towns (IDF data via Globes, 2021).

The strongest kid in school warns before he hits back: 7.2 million leaflets, 13.7 million texts, 15 million calls to Gaza civilians (IDF, Jan 2024). About 1.78 million tons of food entered Gaza from 10 Oct 2025 to 7 Jun 2026 (COGAT, Jul 2026). Critics say warnings and aid were not enough; that debate is real.

Israel gets criticised for how it fights. Scrutiny is fair. But he never stayed down.

Photos: Cyrus Cylinder, Mike Peel (CC BY-SA 4.0); Arch of Titus relief (public domain); Declaration of Independence, Rudi Weissenstein (public domain); Iron Dome interceptions, Shlomo Roded (CC BY 2.5); via Wikimedia Commons. Animated scenes and AI voice.

caption_he:
3,000 שנה. עדיין עומדים. למה?
סיבוב 1: מצרים של פרעה, עבדות ויציאה (ספר שמות, מסורת). סיבוב 2: בבל, חורבן בית ראשון, 586 לפנה"ס. עזרה מהפינה: כורש מלך פרס מחזיר את הגולים, 539 לפנה"ס (עזרא א; גליל כורש). סיבוב 3: מזימת המן (מגילת אסתר, מסורת). סיבוב 4: רומא, חורבן בית שני, 70 לספירה. סיבוב 5: גירוש ספרד, 1492. סיבוב 6: השואה, 6 מיליון נרצחו.
1948: קמים על הרגליים. 1973: הרכבת האווירית האמריקאית, 22,325 טון. ואז האימונים: צבא, סטארטאפים, כיפת ברזל, שעצרה כ־90% מהרקטות שאיימו על ערים ב־2021.
הילד הכי חזק בבית הספר מזהיר לפני שהוא מחזיר: 7.2 מיליון עלונים, 13.7 מיליון הודעות, 15 מיליון שיחות (צה"ל, ינואר 2024), וכ־1.78 מיליון טון מזון נכנסו לעזה בין אוקטובר 2025 ליוני 2026 (מתפ"ש).
ישראל מקבלת ביקורת על הדרך שבה היא נלחמת, והביקורת לגיטימית. אבל הוא אף פעם לא נשאר על הרצפה.

lines.line: Three thousand years. Still standing. Why?
Round one: Pharaoh's Egypt. Slavery, then they walk out.
Round two: Babylon, five eighty-six BCE. The Temple falls.
Help from the corner: Cyrus of Persia sends them home.
Round three: Haman's plot. They survive.
Round four: Rome, seventy CE. The Temple burns again.
Then the darkest round. Six million murdered.
Nineteen seventy-three, on the ropes. America flies in twenty-two thousand tons.
So he trains: an army, startups, Iron Dome.
Nobody shoves him in the hallway. Iron Dome stops nine in ten.
Strongest kid in school? He warns before hitting back.
Seven point two million leaflets, thirteen point seven million texts, fifteen million calls.
Plus one point seven eight million tons of food for Gaza.
Israel gets criticised for how it fights. Scrutiny is fair.
Why so strong? He never stayed down.

transcript.heard: 3,000 years. Still standing. Why? Small corner. The Jewish people. Round 1. Pharaoh's Egypt. Slavery. Then they walk out. Round 2. Babylon. 586 BCE. The temple falls. Help from the corner. Cyrus of Persia sends them home. Round 3. Haman's plot. They survive. Round 4. Rome. 70 CE. The temple burns again. Spain. 1492. Expelled. Then the darkest round. 6 million murdered. 1948, he gets up. 1973, on the ropes. America flies in 22,000 tons, so he trains. An army, startups, Iron Dome, nobody shoves him in the hallway. Iron Dome stops 9 and 10, strongest kid in school, and warns before heading back. 7.2 million leaflets, 13.7 million texts, 15 million calls, plus 1.78 million tons of food for Gaza. Israel gets criticized for how it fights. Scrutiny is fair. Why so strong? Never stayed down.
